{{Quote|The bounty hunter who swindled ''Sli Genchu'' out of the ''Lodan'' job? Word is he's waiting for you back on ''Coruscant''.|[[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]], to [[Arlain Zee]]|<ref name="Lockdown" />}}
The '''Lodan job''' was an event that occurred during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]] earned notoriety and became a wanted man after he swindled [[Sli Genchu]] out of the job. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, during a [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|riot]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'', the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] bounty hunter [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] warned Zee that Genchu was still waiting for him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] because of his actions during the Lodan job.
